thread:
maria: short sync -- proposal to formalize a tiny "lease token" contract between scheduler and adapters so adapters can prefetch/warm without copying scheduler logic.

arthur: 👍. can you outline the minimal guarantees?

maria: scheduler grants LeaseToken {id, expire_ms, credit_hint, warmup_ref}. adapter uses token to warm and calls Redeem(id, actual_cost) at dispatch. scheduler can stream Evict(id) signals. key guarantees: 1) token small on wire, 2) Redeem is CAS (succeeds only if token active), 3) TTL + reconciler to reclaim leaked provisional credits.

jen: what about races when scheduler preempts during Redeem? Redeem should return EVICTED so adapter falls back to cold path. keep behavior simple.

arthur: need metrics: token_hold_time, redeem_conflicts, orphaned_tokens. alert if orphaned_tokens spikes.

tim: rollout plan: feature-flagged API + legacy shim; start 5% hosts, validate tail latency + provisional leak metrics. also keep verbose debug lease behind admin header.

infra-bot: NOTE: created issue #INF-4120 "lease-token-contract + evict stream" (https://redwood/INF-4120)

maria: next steps: i'll draft RFC addendum with sequence diagrams and test plan (adapter crash, network partition, redeem losing to evict). arthur/jen will prototype shim and reconciler. thanks all :rocket:
